name: ATT&CK Framework Blind Spots - No NIST 800-53 Coverage
description: The 223 ATT&CK techniques with NO mapped NIST 800-53 R5 control (CTID). These are framework blind spots that cannot be addressed by control coverage alone and require compensating detection, architecture, or process controls. Darker = used by more threat groups (higher priority). Source: MITRE ATT&CK Enterprise v18.1 + CTID NIST 800-53 R5 mappings.
